description: Retire ten unproven or orphaned skills and strip the ceremony from /retro while keeping the node

userStories.title: Wave 1 — retire the five zero-cascade skills
userStories.description: Delete .agro/skills/{sync,post-bridge,blog,fanout,render-html} and the two probes that guard only them. No other skill references these except /blog -> /post-bridge, which goes with them.
acceptanceCriteria: The five skill directories do not exist
sync-skill-contract.sh and post-bridge-publish-confirmation.sh are deleted with their .agro/evals/RESULTS.md rows
.agro/skills.lock holds no post-bridge or render-html entry and parses
bash .agro/evals/run.sh exits 0 with no REGRESSION

userStories.title: Wave 2 — retire the five cascading skills and sweep their couplings
userStories.description: Delete .agro/skills/{rlm,weigh,imagine,interview,strategic-proposal}, their probes, and every inbound reference. /weigh is orphaned by /rlm's removal; /interview is orphaned by /imagine's.
acceptanceCriteria: The five skill directories do not exist
rlm-context-budget.sh and weigh-scorer-contract.sh are deleted with their .agro/evals/RESULTS.md rows, including the rows citing the nonexistent .agro/tasks/rlm-weighted-trajectories/
.claude/protected-paths.txt no longer lists strategic-proposal; the retro and spec/references/retro.md entries remain
audit-stale-references.sh no longer lists .agro/skills/weigh in its bare_audit caller loop, and prompt-miner-symlink-entrypoint.sh no longer references weigh
Cross-refs cleared in /council (SKILL.md:141, references/scenarios.md:74,80), /plan (SKILL.md:207), /imagine, /retro (SKILL.md:135), /prompt-miner, and docs/glossary.md
bash .agro/evals/run.sh exits 0 with no REGRESSION

userStories.title: Wave 3 — rewrite the retro guard probe before loosening the skill
userStories.description: retro-deterministic-contract.sh pins 8 literals in SKILL.md and mechanically blocks the loosening, so it is rewritten first. It must pin only the three surviving invariants, using short tokens and table cells rather than whole sentences.
acceptanceCriteria: The probe pins exactly three invariants: report-only/no-ledger, no-double-write, and the promotion-line format
No pinned literal is a full hard-wrapped sentence
The ro-a/ro-b negative assertions against the deleted .agro/memory and .agro/context tiers survive
The probe's failure branch is exercised by fault injection, with the injection table recorded as evidence
The probe passes on a tree where /retro is still unmodified

userStories.title: Wave 3 — loosen /retro to three invariants
userStories.description: Strip the ceremony from .agro/skills/retro/SKILL.md, delete references/report-schema.md, and shrink validate-retro-report.sh to checking the promotion-line format /wiki compile parses.
acceptanceCriteria: The falsifiability gate, the 8-column hypothesis table, the five-subsystem lens, STATUS: RETRO-DONE, and the --focus flag are gone from SKILL.md
references/report-schema.md is deleted
A per-lesson [verdict · confidence] tag and the exact promotion line remain, and /wiki compile parses a loosened report against compile.md:65 and gates on it at :76
wiki-compile-contract.sh and roles-are-skills.sh PASS; roles-are-skills.sh still finds .agro/skills/retro/SKILL.md
spec/references/retro.md and spec/references/execute.md step 8 describe the loosened contract
link-providers.sh runs clean and the vendored validate-retro-report.sh symlink resolves

userStories.title: Knowledge impact and campaign measurement
userStories.description: Expected Knowledge Impact is REQUIRED. Resolve the pages the retirements invalidate, and re-score the capability benchmark so the campaign is measured by the instrument it preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/knowledge/source/recursive-language-models.md is resolved explicitly (UPDATED or NOT-AFFECTED with a reason) now that /rlm is gone, not deleted blindly
docs/glossary.md matches the surviving skill set and still satisfies roles-are-skills.sh's five grep assertions
Affected pages carry source-backed bodies and advanced verified_at per .agro/skills/wiki/references/schema.md section 3
bash .agro/evals/probes/wiki-readme-index.sh passes after regenerating .agro/knowledge/README.md
CB-005 re-scored at >= 1.33 in .agro/evals/capability/RESULTS.md
No retired skill name appears in tracked active surfaces over a working-tree scan, not a git ls-files scan
